Hi Samir / Elena,

Thanks again for agreeing to run the hands-on POC with Redwood. To make the kickoff productive we want to lock down three things: the preferred delivery mode (onsite vs virtual), a short agenda for the prompt/replay review, and a 90–120 minute load window where we can run routing and throughput checks against a sample traffic profile.

Proposed options (please pick one):
- Option A — Onsite at CardLoom HQ: Tue 2027-05-25 or Wed 2027-05-26, morning (9:00–12:30 PT). We’ll bring 2 infra engineers and 1 product engineer.
- Option B — Virtual: Thu 2027-05-27 afternoon (13:00–16:00 PT) — full remote run with screen share, streaming, and a remote load generator.

Attached is a draft agenda (poc-agenda-v1.pdf) with sections for: intro & goals, prompt review and evaluation criteria, routing & quantization decisions, and a staged load test plan. Quick asks:
- Confirm which option/date works best for you (and any site constraints for Option A).
- Send an attendee list and any visitor access or security point-of-contact if onsite.
- If onsite, note any A/V limitations (no HDMI, restricted recording, etc.).

We can also open a short preflight call (20m) the week prior to walk through firewall rules and shared-drive access. Calendar link: https://calendar.redwood.ai/s/soojin/30m/CL-0821-kickoff

Cheers,
Soojin Lee
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

Hi Soojin — thanks for the clear options. CardLoom would prefer Option A (onsite) so our product and ops folks can be hands-on with routing decisions. The best date for us is Wed 2027-05-26 (9:00–12:30 PT). A few practical notes from our side:
- Visitor badges are required — I’ve CC’d Courtney (Facilities & Security) to confirm badge process and building access windows.
- Our conference rooms have USB-C/DisplayPort only; no direct HDMI. If you could bring a dongle or use the room’s Crestron system that would be great.
- Recording: internal policy is that recordings need explicit sign-off from legal — we can do local screen share but recording will need a separate approval.
- For the load window, can you share the expected peak qps and an example traffic profile so we can provision a test VLAN?

We’ll send a tentative attendee list by EOD tomorrow. Looking forward to the agenda — thanks for the attachment.

Best,
